
== Japanese Targeting Computer printing (#172) ==
The collecting encyclopedia, p. 100, index 4133 (set count 258), confirms this Light Side Device. Black-border, nonfoil, Uncommon1 rarity. p. 41 dates its Japanese Limited edition to April 1997. <ref name="encyclopedia-172-targeting">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 100. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828id_/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref> The English display name and original-state printing ID <code>1301_39o</code> follow the existing Japanese family-offset convention and the unique English <code>1_39</code> article. The source index and set count are not printing IDs.
